title: Replace is refused when a custom view filters on the value; NDC-2806 S3 says the change carries over (TAVI vs Zoho CRM)
label: BUG
env: TAVI NDC-Staging · set QA GS1111 Tier, Leads view QA GS1111 Silver view · Zoho CRM test org org944965048 · view QA GS1111 Silver view

panels.caption: TAVI · Replace Gold → Silver Plus is refused (toast, box 2)
Zoho · Replace Values Silver Plus → Gold: allowed; view criteria changed to Gold (seen by API)

rows: Replace a value that a custom view filters on
Replace runs; the view criteria change to the new value (seen: Silver Plus → Gold, view still returns the lead)
Refused: "Gold" is used by custom view filters. Change or remove it in those views first.
"Replacing an option automatically propagates the change across existing records and dependent components (workflows, criteria, reports)"
Records only; views block, workflows are skipped (see B2)
